family_name: Sisalation Tuff Wrap and Multipurpose Sarking

spec.description:
Sisalation Tuff Wrap and Multipurpose Sarking (Sisalation 497
Tuff Wrap Standard / Breather and Multipurpose EHD 456) is a renowned range of
heavy-duty reflective foil building membranes designed to protect homes and
buildings against radiant heat, drafts, dust, and moisture. Manufactured with
woven polymer (polyweave) fabric laminated to highly reflective pure aluminium
foil with flame-retardant adhesives, it delivers exceptional tear and puncture
resistance during installation on exposed jobsites. When installed adjacent to
an air cavity, it blocks up to 95% of radiant heat, contributing to total
building R-values.
features:
High-strength woven polyweave reinforcement
delivering exceptional puncture and tear resistance

Reflects up to 95% of
radiant heat when installed facing a minimum 20mm air space

Available in
Standard (Class 1/2 Vapour Barrier) and Breather (pin-perforated) options

Extra Heavy Duty (EHD 456) and Medium Duty (497) classifications to
AS/NZS 4200.1

Water barrier protection shielding timber and steel frames from
weather penetration

Effectively seals building envelopes against drafts and
dust ingress
Low flammability index compliant with AS 1530.2

Suitable for
bushfire-prone zones up to BAL-40 in roof applications and BAL-FZ in walls
Durable foil laminate that will not shrink, delaminate, or crack over time

technical.value:

spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, AS/NZS 4200.2, AS 1530.2, AS 3959, NCC Volume One and Two
spec.sustainability:
Zero ODP, non-hazardous, manufactured with recyclable polymer
and aluminium components
install:
Install horizontally on exterior wall
studs or over roof rafters with anti-glare face facing outward

Overlap upper
layers over lower layers by minimum 150mm to ensure water shedding

Secure to
timber frame using broad-headed galvanized clouts or staples; use self-drilling
screws for steel

Fix at maximum 300mm centres to studs and plates to
withstand wind pressure

Ensure a minimum 20mm air cavity is maintained
adjacent to the reflective face to achieve rated thermal R-values

Seal all
overlaps, edges, and penetrations with Vapastop 883 aluminium foil tape

Ensure wrap is protected by external cladding within manufacturer UV exposure
limits
selection_checklist:
Confirm application (wall wrap vs roof
sarking vs shed lining)

Choose between Standard (vapour barrier for climate
zones 1-3) and Breather (perforated)

Select duty rating (Medium Duty 497 vs
Extra Heavy Duty 456 for high wind/roof traffic)

Measure total area
allowing 150mm overlaps (40.5m² or 81m² rolls)
limitations:
Standard 497 is not
suitable in cold climate zones where vapour-permeable Class 4 wraps are
required

Breather 497 is not suitable where a strict water barrier is
required under lightweight cladding in high rainfall

Must not be left exposed
to direct sunlight beyond recommended exposure window

retrieval.rag_summary:
Sisalation Tuff Wrap and Multipurpose Sarking (Sisalation 497 / 456 EHD) is an
extra-tough reflective foil building membrane manufactured by Fletcher
Insulation. Built with woven polymer (polyweave) reinforcement laminated to pure
aluminium foil, it provides superior resistance to tears and punctures on windy
jobsites while reflecting up to 95% of radiant heat across adjacent air
cavities. Available in Standard vapour-barrier and pin-perforated Breather
formats with a Flammability Index ≤ 5 (BAL 0-40 roof / BAL 0-FZ wall), it
delivers robust weather and radiant heat protection.
